name: NPM-D3A
tagline: Compact dual-beam placer, up to 92,000 cph

intro.text: The Panasonic NPM-D3A is a compact dual-beam high-speed placer with a reinforced frame, an upgraded head and a Multi Recognition Camera. It is built for high-volume work in automotive, industrial and medical electronics.

items: Handles large connectors, odd-shaped parts and PoP
Feeders, nozzles and chucks interchangeable with CM and NPM series
Narrow 832 mm module saves floor space
